title: SOLID and TRACE default +Z wireframe fallback
scope: Provide perimeter LINE callbacks to legacy consumers for SOLID/TRACE using the canonical +Z extrusion, without changing typed callbacks or guessing a transform for other OCS normals.

facts: SOLID stores four OCS corner points in groups 10-13, optional thickness, and an extrusion direction.
If the third and fourth corners are the same, the record represents a triangular SOLID.
TRACE/SOLID raw vertex slots use the unusual perimeter sequence 0-1-3-2.
A triangular record repeats the third corner in the fourth slot, and corrected vertex access omits that duplicate.
independentDxfImplementationDocumentatio.limit: Peer format documentation guides wire-slot ordering; it is not an independent native rendering result.

implementation.behavior: Default DRW_Interface::addTrace and addSolid callbacks emit nondegenerate perimeter edges through addLine only when extPoint is exactly (0,0,1), where OCS coordinates equal WCS. Edges follow raw slots 0-1-3-2-0. Presentation attributes are copied; synthesized handles are cleared. Tilted and malformed normals emit nothing through the fallback. Typed overrides are unchanged.
losses: Boundary lines do not represent filled faces or SOLID/TRACE thickness.
Nondefault extrusion normals require the typed callback or a consumer with an explicit OCS transform path.
No independent native application or file interoperability claim is made.

validation.coverage: Direct base-callback controls verify quadrilateral 0-1-3-2 edge order, triangle duplicate-edge suppression, presentation fields, NoHandle identities, and fail-closed behavior for a tilted extrusion.

fixturePolicy: No DWG or DXF fixture was added.
